por_que: International festival of traditional music and dance in an Alentejo village by the Alqueva, multi-day with camping and a family, international crowd: similar spirit to Waking Life. 2027 dates not yet published.

World music festival in Loulé's old town (Algarve), 4 days, artists from 30 countries in 2026, with gastronomy, crafts and street shows. Dates from VisitPortugal and FestivalFinder, to confirm with the municipality.
Tech conference with 70,000+ attendees from 150+ countries at FIL and MEO Arena. In 2024 its Food Summit had over 100 hand-picked food vendors. Dates 8–11 Nov 2027 from listings, to confirm.
Lisbon edition of Sónar (electronic music, international crowd). No edition in 2026; organisers confirmed it returns in 2027, probably late April or early May.
Medieval market inside Óbidos castle walls, 11 days in July, about 150,000 visitors (2022), many tourists. Food stalls are central to the event. Dates from VisitPortugal, to confirm.

nombre: Viagem Medieval Santa Maria da Feira
por_que: Largest medieval event in Portugal: 12 days, about 650,000 visits expected in 2026. It publishes regulations for food vendors and restaurants each year (2026 link as reference).

por_que: Summer concert series in Cascais (Hipódromo Manuel Possolo and Parque Marechal Carmona) throughout July, mixed local and tourist audience. First 2027 name confirmed.
Two-day hip hop / urban festival in Ericeira, early July every year (2026: 3–4 July). Young local crowd: lower fit, included for review.
Urban culture and music festival (4 days in September 2026) at the former Escola Industrial Afonso Domingues in Marvila, its home until 2027.

por_que: Free outdoor concerts and DJ sets in Oeiras gardens on Sunday afternoons, May–September, now with a monthly Out Market. Recurring, family audience; a market-style slot could suit us.
Large free food festival by Continente at Parque da Cidade do Porto (2 days in July, forecast of 500,000 people in 2026). Brand-run, so vendor access may be limited.
Four-day festival of Lusophone music at Parque Urbano da Costa da Caparica, every August (2026: 13–16 Aug). Mostly local crowd near the beach.

por_que: Daytime electronic music series in Tapada da Ajuda (2–10 pm), eight Sundays in summer 2026 with international DJs. Brunch concept, so food is part of the experience.
MotoGP round at the Algarve circuit, 1–3 October 2027 (official calendar), contract until 2029. Large international crowd; food concessions are usually managed by the circuit.
